item.title: HKTDC twin jewellery shows open in Hong Kong with 4,000 exhibitors
item.description: Retail Jeweller HKTDC twin jewellery shows open in Hong Kong with 4,000 exhibitors Organised by the Hong Kong Trade Development Council (HKTDC), the 12th Hong Kong International Diamond, Gem & Pearl Show has opened at AsiaWorld-Expo yesterday (2 March) and will run for five consecutive days. item.title: Register for the Retail Jeweller Festival and win tickets to the UK Jewellery Awards
